questions.q: After the regain, which picture turns our midfield four into three front options?
options: Both wide players beside the striker
questions.explain: Right. Both wide players join the striker, while the central pair connects behind.
choiceExplanations: With one wide runner, the striker has only one partner and the right lane stays empty.
Staying deep keeps four midfielders, so the lone striker has no help up front.
Right. Both wide players join the striker, while the central pair connects behind.

questions.q: True or false? With a third blue defender back, the high pass is still best.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. The high advantage is gone, so the runner comes nearer before we expand again.
choiceExplanations: A third defender now stands next to that high runner, so the high pass is covered.
Right, it's false. The high advantage is gone, so the runner comes nearer before we expand again.

questions.q: Blue drops a defender onto our high left midfielder. Tap where they reconnect with the carrier.
questions.explain: Right. Coming nearer and wide opens a safe pass, just like the right midfielder did.
choiceExplanations: A defender now stands with that high runner, so going higher keeps them covered.
Right. Coming nearer and wide opens a safe pass, just like the right midfielder did.
Blue players crowd the middle, so a pass inside is easy to cut out.
